sentences.en: My boss called me down for frequent absence from work.
sentences.zh: 我的老板因我频繁缺勤而找我谈话。

sentences.en: Mining-induced earthquakes are a frequent occurrence in the Ruhr area.
sentences.zh: 由于采矿引起的地震在鲁尔区经常发生。

sentences.en: I want you to stop frequenting the graveyard at night.
sentences.zh: 我希望你晚上不要再常去墓地了。

senses.zh: 频繁的；时常发生的；惯常的
